residuals.item: 28 of the 138 findings (20%) carry DIAGNOSIS-INCOMPLETE on their exact file:line, mechanism, or both.

residuals.item: 'Reportedly shipped' is not a reliable completion signal: PR #1287 exists, is correctly scoped and correctly titled for the standing_predictions_read crash, and is OPEN/unmerged with zero effect on live behaviour.
residuals.rationale: A clean natural experiment surfaced by this pass. Any remediation tracking that counts authored PRs as closed findings will systematically overstate completion. Recommended rule: a finding closes on live re-reproduction against production, not on merge and certainly not on PR authorship.
